_about: Settings for the self-improvement loop (scripts/improver.py) on the TrendStrategy bot. It changes ONE variable at a time, tests it, measures it against the goal, and keeps it as the new baseline only if it is better.

goal._about: score = profit % after costs - drawdown_weight x worst drop %. Higher is better. A change must beat the baseline by min_improvement on the search window, and by more than min_improvement_confirm on the confirm window.

windows._about: A daily trend strategy holds coins for weeks, so it needs years to judge. SEARCH = the 4 years before the CONFIRM window; CONFIRM = the most recent 1.5 years, which played no part in picking a change. Both move forward every week.

variables._about: Dotted config path -> the values it may take. Each experiment moves exactly one of these one step up or down from the current baseline.
